_about: List prices in USD copied from the AWS Price List API (https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/<service>/current/<region>/index.json) on 2026-10-25. Primary region US East (N. Virginia), standby region EU (Ireland). Offer versions: AmazonDynamoDB 20260911124422 (both regions: write/read request units, replicated write request units, storage, PITR, restore), AmazonS3 20261015173540 (both regions: storage, Tier1 requests, Replication Time Control transfer), AWSDataTransfer 20260916132208 (us-east-1 to eu-west-1 inter-region transfer), AWSBackup 20261014001856 (DynamoDB warm backup storage in both regions, cross-region copy transfer, restore), AmazonRoute53 20260911124504 (hosted zone, health checks, alias queries). Reused from chapter 2: CloudWatch alarm and custom-metric prices (AmazonCloudWatch 20261007115540). First tier only; no free-tier allowance is applied, so DynamoDB storage ignores the 25 free GB-months and Route 53's free first 50 AWS-endpoint health checks IS applied because it is written into the list price itself (the first 50 cost $0.00). Two things could not be fetched from the sandbox and are from the AWS documentation as remembered: that global tables bill inter-region replication traffic at the inter-region transfer rate (modelled; it rounds to zero at every scale here), and that S3 replication metrics are four CloudWatch custom metrics per rule (ReplicationLatency, BytesPendingReplication, OperationsPendingReplication, OperationsFailedReplication). Each AWS Backup recovery point of a DynamoDB table is modelled as a full copy of the table. Re-check before quoting to anyone.
